title: Promote exponent and radical rewrite definitions
summary: Promote exponent expansion/lowering and radical-to-power rewrite semantics into reusable transform definitions that distinguish persistent bases from non-persistent notation artifacts.

sourceRefs.summary: Exponent and radical generated fixture specs.

expectedLearning: How exponent tokens, radical glyphs, indices, and bases should declare persistence.
Which rewrite law refs prove the radical/power relationship without relying on visual diffing.
allowedWork: Add or wire exponent and radical transform definitions.
Keep visual geometry and particle effects out of semantic definitions.
disallowedWork: Do not change radical animation rendering.
Do not broaden into function wrapping or distribution.
